news_bbc.title: We bought our £242,000 home without a deposit - here's how
news_bbc.summary: The share of UK mortgages with smaller deposits is the highest it's been since 2008. The BBC spoke to borrowers about how they manage the risks.

news_bbc.title: Healey to ask EU finance ministers to let UK into Made in Europe scheme
news_bbc.summary: The chancellor wants the Made in Europe programme to deepen ties with the UK "rather than erecting new barriers".

news_bbc.title: Thames Water rescue deal should be rejected - MPs
news_bbc.summary: A report on the future of Thames Water, urging the government to take action, has been published.

news_bbc.title: Japan raises interest rate to new 31-year high to curb rising prices
news_bbc.summary: Central banks around the world have hiked rates as high energy prices are pushing up inflation.

news_bbc.title: Early Bowie music available to stream for first time
news_bbc.summary: Previously unheard material from the start of the artist's career has been released for the first time.

news_bbc.title: The virtual worlds where robots are trained
news_bbc.summary: Training systems that allow robots to negotiate the real world are getting more sophisticated.

news_bbc.title: Interest rates held but Bank signals rise if energy prices stay high
news_bbc.summary: Rates are held for the sixth time in a row but the Bank of England says high energy prices make a future rise more likely.

news_bbc.title: Barclays workers ask for more money to return to the office
news_bbc.summary: Unite union, which represents 36,000 Barclays staff, calls for a one-off payment to offset increased travel and childcare costs.
